result.quote: Since he had much livestock in the foothills and in the plain, he built towers in the desert and dug many cisterns.
result.reason: Verse 26:10 directly links digging the cisterns to Uzziah’s much livestock. The separate statement about loving the soil explains why he employed farmers and vinedressers, so it is not an equally defensible answer. The wording is natural and specific. However, the edit changes the answer target from Uzziah’s love of farming in the prepared item to his livestock; the source pair also had a broader combined scope involving cattle and farming.
